summary_en: 4,400,000 shares (2.2% of shares outstanding), ¥5.0B upper limit, execution window Aug 12, 2026 to Jun 30, 2027, method not disclosed. Stated rationale: shareholder returns and capital efficiency through opportunistic acquisition based on investment opportunities, cash position, and stock price levels.
title_en: Notice of resolution on matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: SHO-BOND Holdings announced on 10 August 2026 that its board of directors has authorized a treasury share acquisition program. The company will acquire up to 4,400,000 shares (2.2% of shares outstanding, based on 200,532,640 shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 31 July 2026) with an aggregate upper limit of ¥5.0 billion. The acquisition period runs from 12 August 2026 to 30 June 2027. The company stated that the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency through opportunistic buybacks undertaken after comprehensive consideration of investment opportunities, cash position, and stock price levels. The notice indicates that the full authorized amount may not be executed depending on investment opportunities and market conditions.
